issuer.summary: Effectively **no issuer counterparty** — and unusually, this is verified rather than asserted: owner renounced to `address(0)`, no proxies on any core contract, `setBranchAddresses` reverts on the Ownable check for every possible caller, mint authority permanently closed to three branches, collateral set permanently frozen, no pause, no parameter setter, no upgrade path. Governance controls only the routing of 25% of interest revenue and the docs state it has no other powers. This removes essentially the entire admin-key risk class. Held to 8.0 rather than higher by track record (§III.4): a critical bug in **base code** survived six audit firms plus formal verification, surfaced three weeks post-launch, **its root cause was never published**, and immutability meant the only remediation was full redeployment plus manual migration — leaving 220,899 BOLD permanently stranded. The $125k critical bounty cap (0.16% of TVL) is weak insurance against a repeat.
facts: Checked on live BOLD 0x6440f144b7e50D6a8439336510312d2F54beB01D: owner() = address(0) and the EIP-1967 implementation slot is zero. The legacy 0xb01dd87B29d187F3E3a4Bf6cdAebfb97F3D9aB98 token is a different deployment whose symbol differs only by case.

Checked the core authority construction: three fixed mint branches, a permanently closed WETH / wstETH / rETH collateral set, no pause, no upgrade path and no mutable core parameter or oracle setter were established in the assessment and completed authority walk.

No corporate issuer holds off-chain reserves or owes BOLD redemption. BOLD is debt minted by an ownerless protocol against on-chain collateral; therefore there is no issuer balance sheet, custodian or legal redemption claim to verify.

No issuer does NOT mean no organization or team: Liquity AG and protocol contributors exist, and Liquity AG grants the BUSL license. It also does not mean no Chainlink, Lido, Rocket Pool, sBOLD-wrapper or LQTY-governance dependency.

Governance is not absent. The LQTY allocator can direct the bounded weekly initiative allocation from its own BOLD balance, but the completed walk found no path from that allocator into core branches, oracles, parameters, code or authorized contracts.

The verified absence is bounded to the core contracts and selectors walked as of 2026-09-14. The OwnershipTransferred renunciation event was not read, Chainlink feed governance was outside the walk, and LQTY voter concentration and majority cost were not measured.
There is no verified public BOLD assessment URL. The report state is unpublished; no link is supplied.
